texts.preamble: Nagasubramanian vs The Chief Secretary To Government on 8 September, 2016 Author: V.Bharathidasan Bench: V.Bharathidasan Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated: 08.09.2016 Coram The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice V.Bharathidasan Writ Petition (MD)No.16665 of 2015 Nagasubramanian . . . Petitioner -Vs- 1.The Chief Secretary to Government Secretariat, Chennai-9. 2.The Principal Secretary, Health and Family Welfare Department, Secretariat, Chennai-9. 3.The Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Dms Campus, Theynampet, Chennai-6. 4.The Additional Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Dms Campus, Theynampet, Chennai-6. 5.The Designated Officer, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Dean Quarters, Tirunelveli Medical College Campus, Palayamkottai, Tirunelveli-2. . . . Respondents Prayer:
texts.facts: The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking a direction to the respondents 3 to 5 to grant necessary sanction for prosecution, under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 2. According to the petitioner, he is working as a Food Safety Officer, Ambasamudram, Tirunelveli District and on inspection, he seized many food samples under the Act and sent it for analyst for analysis. After receipt of report from the analysis, he sought for sanction from the third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6, for initiating prosecution. According to the petitioner, even though the third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6 granted sanction, he omitted to include important penal provisions in the Sanction Order. 3.The grievance of the petitioner is that even as per the analyst report and inspection report filed by him, there are many violations under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, for which he requires sanction, but the third respondent without considering all the relevant materials, granted sanction for lessor offence. 4.Under the above circumstances, without going into the merits of the case, the petitioner is directed to approach the third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6 and place all the materials available with him, for getting necessary sanction and the third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6 is directed to consider the same and issue proper sanction order, as per Law. Thereafter, third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6 is to pass order in accordance with law within a period of six weeks.
